title: Milo and the Tall Wall
refrain: Small steps, tall wall, we go on
description_hook: A small boy, a tall wall, and one good idea.

characters.name: Milo
characters.description: six years old, curly hair, yellow shirt

scenes.narration: Milo stood by the tall wall and looked at the small ball on the other side of it all. Small steps, tall wall, we go on.
scenes.caption: Milo दीवार के पास खड़ा था और गेंद देख रहा था।
scenes.image_brief: Milo, a small boy, standing beside a tall garden wall looking at a ball, warm light

scenes.narration: Milo called out to all his friends but the tall wall was always too tall for a small boy to climb at all.
scenes.caption: Milo ने सब दोस्तों को बुलाया पर दीवार बहुत ऊँची थी।
scenes.image_brief: Milo calling out beside a tall wall, small hands raised, afternoon light

scenes.narration: The wall was tall and the small ball stayed on the other side. Milo felt small and the wall felt taller than all.
scenes.caption: दीवार ऊँची थी और गेंद उधर ही रही।
scenes.image_brief: Milo standing small against a tall wall, long shadows

scenes.narration: Then Milo saw a small crate called a step by the wall. Small steps, tall wall, we go on. He climbed it, one careful foot at a time.
scenes.caption: तभी Milo ने दीवार के पास एक पेटी देखी।
scenes.image_brief: Milo placing one foot on a small crate beside a tall wall, careful face, golden light

scenes.narration: From the crate Milo reached over the tall wall and the small ball came back to him. He laughed and called to all.
scenes.caption: पेटी से Milo ने गेंद उठा ली और हँस पड़ा।
scenes.image_brief: Milo on a crate reaching over a tall wall holding a ball, laughing, warm light

scenes.narration: Small steps, tall wall, we go on.
scenes.caption: छोटे कदम, ऊँची दीवार, हम चलते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Milo sitting by the wall with the ball in his lap, evening light, calm
